accent-vibrant.note: Used as a raw fill only for the 6px status dot inside success badges (estado ACTIVO, contrato Vigente) -- the one deliberate exception to badges always using the desaturated -ink/-surface pair.

display.purpose: Page-level titles only (e.g. record name on a detail page, module titles). Never marketing-hero scale.

headline.purpose: Section / tab-panel headers within a page.

title.purpose: Card headers, modal titles, table section headers.

body.purpose: Form field values, paragraph text, modal copy. WCAG floor -- never smaller than 1rem.

data.purpose: Dense table cells only (0.875rem) -- the one place text legitimately drops below Body size.

label.purpose: Table column headers and form field labels only -- functional micro-label, not a decorative eyebrow.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns, popovers, date pickers, info tooltips -- anything detached from normal page flow.

zIndex.name: tooltip
zIndex.note: Top of the scale -- a tooltip must never be occluded by a modal, toast, or sticky nav open at the same time.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default ease-out-quint for state transitions, hover/focus feedback, panel open/close.

motion.name: scroll-easing
motion.purpose: Wraps every independently-scrolling content pane so wheel/touch scroll eases continuously instead of stepping section-by-section. Native scrollTop under the hood (position: sticky stays compatible); sidebar nav and fixed chrome stay outside it; respects prefers-reduced-motion by default.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #232BED; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.0625rem; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1B21C4; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #232BED; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Underline Tab Item
components.description: Horizontal section nav for short sets (<=~8 sections). Underline indicator, scrolls horizontally when the list overflows.
components.css: .ds-tab { font-family: "TT Firs Neue", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #2B3341; background: none; border: none; padding: 10px 4px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: #10151F; } .ds-tab-active { color: #10151F; border-bottom-color: #232BED; }

components.name: Vertical Section Nav Item
components.description: Sticky vertical nav for detail views past ~8 sections. 224px sticky column beside the content card; collapses to a horizontal scrollable row below ~900px.
components.css: .ds-section-nav-item { display: block; font-family: Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; color: #2B3341; text-decoration: none; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 6px; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-section-nav-item:hover { background: #EEF1F5; color: #10151F; } .ds-section-nav-item-active { background: #EEF1F5; color: #232BED; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Global Edit Toggle
components.description: Record-editing views open read-only. One Editar button top-right of the page header (in line with the title, outside the content card) switches the whole page into edit mode; swaps to Cancelar + Guardar. Never repeated per section -- driven by one boolean gating every section's <fieldset disabled>.

components.name: Info Tooltip
components.description: Explains a non-obvious KPI/chart on hover or keyboard focus (never hover-only). Trigger is a 14px 'i' glyph right after the title. Bubble: Ink bg / Surface text, Data typography, rounded-sm, Floating shadow, z-index tooltip (500, top of the scale).

components.css: .ds-tooltip-trigger { position: relative; display: inline-flex; color: #545E70; cursor: help; } .ds-tooltip-trigger:hover, .ds-tooltip-trigger:focus-visible { color: #232BED; } .ds-tooltip-bubble { position: absolute; z-index: 500; bottom: calc(100% + 8px); left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, 4px); max-width: 220px; background: #10151F; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.45; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(16, 21, 31, 0.12); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-tooltip-trigger:hover .ds-tooltip-bubble, .ds-tooltip-trigger:focus-visible .ds-tooltip-bubble { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, 0); pointer-events: auto; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Primary left-nav item; active state uses Azul Profundo, a small contained brand moment per the Rationed Brand Rule.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: block; font-family: Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #2B3341; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #EEF1F5; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #0B2D4D; color: #FFFFFF; }

narrative.overview: A tool that behaves like a well-kept ledger, not a marketing surface: every screen is built to be scanned fast, trusted completely, and never ambiguous. aed's own brand identity is bold, dynamic, and vibrant (a signature green-to-blue gradient, electric blue, bright green) -- this product wears that identity as a precise accent, not as a wash across dense data screens. Color earns its place; most of the interface is calm, cool-tinted neutral so that the two moments of real color -- a primary action, a status badge, the login/empty-state gradient -- read as deliberate, not decorative. The product rejects two failure modes equally: the outdated enterprise look (dense gray forms, unlabeled tables, generic icon sets) and the generic AI-SaaS look (identical cards, gradient hero metrics, uppercase eyebrows, side-stripe borders).
keyCharacteristics: Cool, blue-tinted neutral canvas -- never the warm cream/sand AI default
Azul Vibrante and Verde Vibrante appear only as precise accents, never as large fills
A record's detail view is the hub: sections, not scattered top-level CRUD screens -- underline tabs for short sets, sticky vertical nav past ~8 sections
Flat-by-default surfaces with tonal layering; shadows reserved for floating elements only
Responsive motion without choreography -- confidence through clarity, not spectacle
Every independently-scrolling pane eases its scroll via Lenis so long pages read as one continuous surface
Record-editing views open read-only; one global Editar control gates the whole page into edit mode at once

rules.name: The No-Cream Rule
rules.body: Off-white aed (#F0ECE6) is a warm print neutral from the brand manual -- right for business cards and letterhead, wrong for a screen. It never appears as the app canvas.

rules.name: The Rationed Brand Rule
rules.body: Azul Vibrante and Verde Vibrante combined should never cover more than roughly 10% of any given screen's surface area.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Any column of numbers (salarios, dias, cedulas, valores) uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so digits align vertically.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Rule
rules.body: If it doesn't detach from the page's normal flow, it doesn't get a shadow. Depth is earned by z-index, not applied by default.

rules.name: The Fluid Scroll Rule
rules.body: Every independently-scrolling content pane is wrapped in Lenis (root={false}) so scroll input eases into a continuous glide instead of stepping section by section. Native scrollTop under the hood keeps position: sticky compatible. Sidebar nav and fixed chrome stay outside it. Respects prefers-reduced-motion by default.

rules.name: The Full-Width Form Rule
rules.body: Forms take the full content width, organized into horizontal rows of fields grouped by named section -- never a single narrow vertical field stack.

rules.name: The View/Edit Mode Rule
rules.body: Record-editing views render read-only by default. One global Editar/Guardar/Cancelar control lives in the page header, never repeated per section -- driven by one shared boolean gating each section's fieldset disabled.

rules.name: The Explain-on-Demand Rule
rules.body: A dense dashboard's KPIs and charts get their explanation via an Info Tooltip next to the title (hover + keyboard focus, role=tooltip), not via permanent caption text under every tile -- permanent captions on every tile is the identical-card-grids AI-SaaS tell wearing a data-viz costume. Reserve a permanent caption for context that's load-bearing to read the chart correctly at a glance.

dos: Do keep the app canvas cool-tinted neutral (#F7F8FA family) -- never the warm cream/sand AI default.
Do reserve Azul Vibrante and Verde Vibrante for actions, status, and identity moments.
Do use underline tabs for short section sets and a sticky vertical nav once a detail view outgrows a tab row.
Do use tabular-nums on every numeric table column.
Do give every loading/empty/error state real, deliberate content.
Do let list/table views and forms use the full content width, with form fields grouped into horizontal rows by named section.
Do gate an existing record's fields behind one global Editar/Guardar/Cancelar control in the page header.
Do wrap every independently-scrolling content pane in Lenis so scrolling eases continuously.
Do explain a non-obvious KPI or chart with an Info Tooltip next to its title instead of a permanent caption under every tile.
donts: Don't replicate the SAP/Oracle-2000s look: dense gray forms, generic icons, unlabeled cramped tables.
Don't ship generic AI-SaaS scaffolding: identical cards, gradient hero metrics, uppercase eyebrows, side-stripe borders.
Don't let the interface feel like a playful consumer app.
Don't use Off-white aed (#F0ECE6) as a screen background.
Don't add a shadow to anything that isn't floating above the page.
Don't apply gradient-text anywhere -- the aed gradient is a graphic accent element, never a text treatment.
Don't repeat an Editar/Guardar/Cancelar control inside every tab or section of a detail view -- one global control per page.
Don't grow the accent-vibrant status dot into a stripe, larger chip, or full badge fill -- it stays a 6px indicator.
